title: Opponent Aware Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:1908.08773v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In certain reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios there are adversaries trying to interfere with the underlying reward process for their own benefit. We introduce Threatened Markov Decision Processes (TMDPs) as a framework to support an agent against potential opponents in an RL context as well as schemes resulting in novel learning approaches to deal with TMDPs. After introducing our framework and deriving theoretical results, empirical evidence is given via extensive experiments, showing the importance for an RL agent of acknowledging adversarial awareness.

translated_abstract: 在某些强化学习（RL）场景中，存在试图为了自身利益干扰底层奖励过程的对手。我们引入了受威胁马尔可夫决策过程（TMDPs）作为框架，以在RL环境中支持智能体对抗潜在对手，并提出了导致处理TMDPs的新颖学习方法的方案。在介绍我们的框架并推导理论结果后，通过大量实验提供了经验证据，展示了RL智能体识别对手意识的重要性。
tldr: 本文提出受威胁马尔可夫决策过程（TMDPs）框架，并开发了对手感知的强化学习算法，通过理论分析和实验证明智能体在对抗环境中考虑对手意识至关重要。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Threatened Markov Decision Processes (TMDPs) as a framework and develops opponent-aware RL algorithms, demonstrating through theory and experiments that acknowledging adversarial awareness is crucial for agents in adversarial environments.
